executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

active.title: Sicurezza clinica e guardrail
active.outcome: Pain, risk and stop conditions fail closed throughout the product.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated durable safety evidence represents pain, stop conditions, relevant risk flags and source provenance without silently relaxing prior guardrails.
Plan generation, contextual substitution, execution and adaptation all consume the same safety contract and fail closed before unsafe load or exercise progression.
Safety-triggered stops and recoveries persist with explicit audit provenance, remain coherent after restart/retry, and prevent later recommendations from bypassing unresolved risk evidence.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot pain/stop/recovery journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Ricezione merce e riconciliazione
active.outcome: Receiving updates orders, lots and stock atomically and idempotently.

exitCriteria.description: Durable receiving records bind purchase order, supplier, product, quantity, cost, lot/expiry evidence and operator attribution to canonical commercial and inventory identities.
Accepted receipts update purchase-order fulfillment, lot state and inventory atomically while mismatched, excess, expired or incomplete evidence fails closed into an explicit discrepancy state.
Duplicate, retried and concurrent receipt operations are idempotent and preserve immutable correction/reconciliation history without double-posting stock or commercial quantities.
Operator receiving and reconciliation journeys expose pending, partial, complete and exception states with searchable discrepancies and no silent quantity or cost mutation.

Product CI, independent review, PFarma receiving/reconciliation delta Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge cumulative replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Video, miniature e pipeline media
active.outcome: Photo and video processing is reliable, bounded and recoverable.

exitCriteria.description: Durable canonical processing jobs bind original media identity to requested thumbnail/video derivatives, processing version and family authorization without replacing original bytes.
Thumbnail and video processing are deterministic and resource-bounded, verify derivative integrity, and fail closed with explicit actionable error states on unsupported or corrupt input.
Processing retries, restart and concurrency are idempotent, recoverable and never duplicate or orphan canonical derivatives; failed jobs can resume without data loss.
Authorized browsing and shared-media journeys resolve only verified derivatives and preserve explicit unavailable/processing/error states without leaking source metadata.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot photo/video processing journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
